# G6 compatibility artifacts

These are actual run bundles generated by the source at G6 commit
`21b570355304bf89a8b07b82c5470a6564164d35`, not by the G7 legacy adapter.
No pre-existing historical run directory was available in the repository.

Generation used `git archive <commit>` extracted into a temporary directory,
then Python 3.14.8 ran `generate.py <temporary-source-root> <this-directory>`.
The script puts only that old checkout's `src` first on the import path. Its
fixtures, reducer, projector, validator and store all come from the old commit.
The old source remained unchanged. `provenance.json` records payload digests.

Cases: cancellation with private text, repeated search/check history ending
INCOMPLETE, and a patch/check/virtual submission ending SUBMITTED. The original
public log uses LEV IDs and can contain private termination text. These are
administrative test inputs, never a researcher export. Tests load them through
the current store, verify them with frozen G6 rules, and retrieve only G7 outputs.

This demonstrates compatibility with the pinned G6 store contract and these
three cases. It does not assert compatibility with all earlier development
commits or unrecorded formats. Manifests include the generation environment;
that environment is provenance, not a requirement to match the reader's OS.
